text.tspan: admission: a LEASE decided at the exchange's start
— not evidence of admission at any act
OPEN (agenda A1): the DE issuer MUST verify this receipt, and no published operation delivers it to any RDP
composing is an act: RDP(out) admitted at the EP's own QTS instant
Phase 7 — Verification (later, by any relying party)
qualification and admission are independent gates — neither implies the other

svg.text: resolve(UID-B)
DirectoryRecord (status, med_url, pinned seal keys) — sealed
GET BW-MED / BW-ORG / BW-MEMBER
sealed documents — verified against the pinned keys (LINT-TRUST-05)
reserve KeyPackages for B's devices (Idempotency-Key)
reservation + keypackage_ref per device (RFC 9420 RefHash)
commit reservation — packages CONSUMED from here
create group (A+B devices), pin sbm_group_params, Commit
deposit one Welcome per device (+ group_info_commitment)
register as the group's founder · device-authenticated — MLS adds no Welcome for its creator
collect WelcomeQueue (Welcome + commitment + offered_suite)
decrypt Welcome, recompute GroupInfo commitment, verify credentials
join group
acknowledge (DELETE /welcome/{welcome_id}) — joining: the routing claim outlives the Welcome's expiry
refuse (POST /welcome/{welcome_id}/refusal · group-info-mismatch / suite-below-published-floor)
creator collects the typed outcome (GET /group-establishment/outcomes)
build envelope, payload_hash, encrypt · SIGN the submission tuple (sender_confirmation)
submit(exact MLSMessage octets + metadata) · authenticated member session
validate request, identity, expiry, policy, sender signature — before anything moves
POST /messages (the SAME octets) · RDP credential
accept — digest computed HERE · items only for devices it observed joining (here: none)
AcceptanceRecord (binds octets, issuing RDP, message_id)
SE (A.1-SubmissionAcceptance) — sealed + qualified timestamp, AFTER acceptance
POST /relay/messages — the SAME octets + the sealed SE
verify the SE's seal · SHA-256(octets) == the SE's envelope_hash, or refuse the hop
POST /messages as forwarder · origin = RDP(out) + its sealed SE
origin proven by the SE · keyed (RDP(out), message_id) · one item per device it observed joining (B's, and the founder)
AcceptanceRecord — issuing_rdp_id RDP(out), forwarding_rdp_id RDP(in)
POST /relay/messages/{message_id}/result — B.1 RelayAcceptance (or B.2), sealed + QTS at this hop
collect (device-authenticated) → transferred + collection token
acknowledge (receipt-ack, collection token)
DeliveryReceipt — DS-signed, server-observed instant = S2
decrypt, recompute payload_hash
confirmation s3 (wallet-signed or member-bound session)
verify signer · roster (active ack-capable member) · tuple == SE
evaluate acceptance_policy — S4 when the completing member's confirmation arrives (any-one ⇒ S4 == S3)
DE — delivered_at = when RDP(in) verified the completing confirmation, never the S2 receipt · embeds s3_attestation
confirmation mismatch — the recipient's signed proof
NDE (D.2, payload-hash-mismatch) — carries that proof
NDE (expired) — silence is never a mismatch
compose EP: se + outcome + rdp_chain[RDP(out), RDP(in)] — sealed + QTS
EP (wallet-storable)
EP / DE (wallet-storable)
decode artefact [COSE_Sign1, QTS] · verify seal over dCBOR(body) · QTS imprints SHA-256(seal)
validate decoded body against its JSON Schema (authoritative) · payload_hash == held plaintext
admission of every provider at its act's instant (authenticated register) · QSealC → Trusted Lists (production)
